subject: Our mailbox is down: price for Ho Chi Minh City (SGN)
body:
Hello,

our usual mailbox has been down since this morning and I cannot open anything in it. Could you confirm your price for our shipment to Ho Chi Minh City (SGN) to this address, so that I can pass it on today?

Sara
Lindqvist Medtech

classification.reasoning: The customer asks us to confirm the price for a shipment, but does not provide a new transport request or accept a quote.
